summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on integrating height data derived from 2D lidar into the system. [p1] confirmed the need for a dedicated column to store this float data, measured in meters.

Later, there was a technical discussion regarding data flow issues. Initially, data appeared to stop entering the system, but later it was noted that the 2D lidars collect and transmit data in large batches (series). [p1] explained that while they currently collect data over five-minute intervals, it is possible to revert to 30-second transmission once traffic issues are resolved. It was confirmed that the lidar data streams are not synchronized to exact five-minute intervals.
decisions: A dedicated column for height (float, in meters) will be added to store 2D lidar data.
action_items: [p1] will investigate the data flow issue and check if a return to 30-second data transmission is feasible after fixing traffic issues.
